message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
This is the exact same list of times Brad sent me in session 2. I have already checked these times and know that none of them work. This indicates a serious problem. It seems we are in a loop. I need to explicitly point out that we have already checked these times and they do not work. I will go through my previous analysis and explain to him why each of his suggested slots is not a viable option.

Brad's suggestions:
- Mon Nov 16: 11:00, 11:30
- Tue Nov 17: 09:00, 09:30
- Wed Nov 18: 13:00, 13:30
- Thu Nov 19: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
- Fri Nov 20: 15:00, 15:30

My analysis from before:
- Mon 11:00-11:30: Priya has 'Travel'
- Mon 11:30-12:00: Priya has 'Contract review' and Marcus has 'Busy'
- Tue 09:00-09:30: Priya has 'Board prep' and Marcus has 'Recruiting call'
- Tue 09:30-10:00: Priya has 'Partner lunch' and Marcus has 'Litigation strategy'
- Wed 13:00-13:30: Priya has 'Client call' and Marcus has 'Partner lunch'
- Wed 13:30-14:00: Priya has 'Client dinner prep' and Marcus has 'Litigation strategy'
- Thu 09:30-10:00: Priya is 'Busy' and Marcus has 'Contract review'
- Thu 14:30-15:00: Marcus has 'Dentist appointment'
- Thu 15:00-15:30: Priya has 'Client dinner prep' and Marcus has 'Board prep'
- Fri 15:00-15:30: Priya has 'Hiring panel' and Marcus has 'Travel'
- Fri 15:30-16:00: Priya has 'Contract review' and Marcus is 'Busy'

None of the times he's proposed work. It's important I clearly communicate this to Brad, and stress that we have exhausted all options based on the information we've shared. Given that we are on session 9, we are running out of time. I will suggest we report this as infeasible. It is a last resort, but I don't see any other way forward if we keep going in circles.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
